summary: Line cook with sous chef title and roughly a decade of combined food service, warehouse, and retail experience, most recently in fast-paced, high-volume restaurant kitchens. Skilled in prep for soups, sauces, salads, and catered hors d'oeuvres, working multiple line stations including sauté, fryer, salad, and flattop, and developing allergy- and diet-restriction-friendly menu items such as gluten-free and vegan dishes. Has instructed cooks on preparation, garnishing, and plating, and contributed to a large inventory count with near-zero variance. Brings a background in receiving, shipping, and inventory management alongside customer-facing service and CPR/AED certification.
